name: Seeed XIAO nRF52840 (Sense)

reserved.20-25: Wired to the 2 MB QSPI flash chip.

avoid.14: Battery-read enable. Drive it low to read the battery on 31. Never set it high while charging: that can damage pin 31.
avoid.31: Battery voltage divider, read only with the ADC. Never drive it.
avoid.13: Sets the battery charge current (low: 100 mA, high: 50 mA).
avoid.17: Charge LED, also driven by the charger chip. Read it to see whether the battery is charging; don't drive it.

notes: The plain XIAO nRF52840 and the Sense run the same MicroPython firmware and both report XIAO nRF52840 Sense. D0-D5 are also A0-A5; D4/D5 are the usual I2C SDA/SCL, D6/D7 UART TX/RX, D8-D10 SPI SCK/MISO/MOSI. The RGB LED is active low: value 0 turns it on. NFC1/NFC2 are pads on the back. IMU (LSM6DS3TR-C) and microphone pins exist on the Sense only; set IMU_PWR or MIC_PWR high before using them. Files live under /flash. Bluetooth is through ubluepy only.
